messages:
maria-recruiter: Morning team 5: spotted an issue after last night's ATS bulk import 5: several candidate packet attachments are zero bytes in the ATS UI. Noticed during triage. :grimacing:

maria-recruiter: Job id=559, total rows ~4.2k, affected ~38 attachments (~0.9%). Original files were ~1-3MB each.

maria-recruiter: Import log excerpt:``` 
2026-03-23T04:12:33Z INFO import: starting batch 34/42
2026-03-23T04:12:38Z WARN upload: attachment 0x7f9b truncated while streaming
2026-03-23T04:12:38Z WARN upload: retrying (1/3)
2026-03-23T04:12:40Z WARN upload: attachment 0x7f9b truncated while streaming
2026-03-23T04:12:40Z ERROR upload: max retries exceeded for attachment 0x7f9b
2026-03-23T04:12:42Z INFO import: batch 34 completed
```

maria-recruiter: @alex-ops can you check whether this is the attachment-proxy timing out again? We had a similar flake last quarter but it usually left failed rows flagged, not zero-byte objects.

alex-ops: On it. Quick triage q: are the zero-byte objects present in the raw staging bucket or only after ATS post-processing?

maria-recruiter: Staging objects look fine on spot-check. Zero-byte versions appear after ATS move into the service storage.

sarah-peopleops: We use these packets for next-day interviews. If rehydration is needed, please flag candidates so we can notify recruiters and hiring teams.

jamie-atsbot: job 559 status: COMPLETED with warnings. Detected 38 attachments with E_UPLOAD_TRUNCATED from putAttachment(). See runbook: https://docs/internal/ats/runbooks#E_UPLOAD_TRUNCATED

leo-eng: Pulling ATS post-processing logs. Can someone drop the manifest id?

maria-recruiter: manifest-id: import-20260323-559.json. Small sample payload uploaded: https://drive.redwood/incoming/559-sample.zip

leo-eng: Found repeated 499/timeouts from internal attachment-proxy during the final move:``` 
[2026-03-23T04:12:38Z] proxy: upstream returned 499 while reading response header
[2026-03-23T04:12:38Z] proxy: wrote 0 of 327680 bytes
```

leo-eng: That explains zero-byte symptom 5: proxy dropped mid-stream but our post-process currently marks uploads as stored without checksum validation on that codepath.

alex-ops: Immediate mitigation: rehydrate from staging and add checksum verification before marking stored. Longer term disable optimistic-success flagging.

maria-recruiter: Staging copies are intact for the samples I checked.

anne-hiring-manager: We have interviews tomorrow that need those packets. Please prioritize rehydrate for candidates in my teams and cc me on the list.

sarah-peopleops: Proposed actions:
1) Engineering add checksum verification + retry on proxy abort (leo).
2) Ops run rehydrate from staging for manifest import-20260323-559.json (alex).
3) People Ops will notify affected recruiters and hiring managers (sarah).

leo-eng: Will open a small PR to add post-process checksum verification and a fallback download retry. ETA EOD for PR, can hotfix if needed.

alex-ops: Kicking off rehydrate dry-run now:``` 
$ ./tools/ats_rehydrate --manifest import-20260323-559.json --dry-run
Found 38 attachments flagged as truncated. Candidates: 6, 12, 19, 24, 31, 45, ...
```

alex-ops: Dry-run looks good. Running actual rehydrate in ~10m, will verify checksums after restore.

maria-recruiter: Please proceed. I will alert the affected recruiters after confirmation.

jamie-atsbot: rehydrate job queued as 560 by alex-ops. Notifying stakeholders.

alex-ops: Rehydrate finished. 38 attachments restored from staging, checksums verified. job 560 exit=0.

leo-eng: Patch merged to main with checksum verification and extra verification step in post-processing. Rolling to canaries.

sarah-peopleops: Thank you. I'll post a brief update to #recruiters summarizing impact and recovered list. If this recurs for other imports, please re-open thread. :handshake:

maria-recruiter: Huge thanks 5: saved the morning for multiple teams. :coffee:
